description: Tor Browser will launch and connect to the Tor network. Once connected (showing 'Explore. Privately.' or the DuckDuckGo search page), change the security level from 'Standard' to 'Safer' or 'Safest'. To do this, click on the shield icon in the toolbar (or go to Settings > Privacy & Security) and change the Security Level setting. The 'Safer' level disables some features on sites that can be dangerous while 'Safest' only allows features required for basic sites. Note: You may need to wait for the Tor connection to be established and click 'Connect' if prompted.
